Model.RequiredFields: code, phase, severity, primarySpan, message, cause
Model.SourceSpan: Internally represented as file identity plus UTF-8 byte start/end offsets. Human line/column is derived for presentation.

MlxDiagnostics.Phases: source, lexer, parser, resolve, sema, comptime, lowering, codegen, linker, stdlib
MlxDiagnostics.StableCodes: Diagnostic codes are stable for the Mlx 1.x language line. Human prose may improve without changing the code when the semantic condition is unchanged.
MlxDiagnostics.Determinism: For identical source, target, language version and compiler version, diagnostics are emitted deterministically by canonical file identity, primary byte offset, phase order, then diagnostic code. Parallel compilation must not randomize ordering.

Recovery.Parser: After a recoverable parser error, synchronize at STATEMENT_END, closing brace, or a valid top-level declaration start while preserving nesting depth.
Recovery.Sema: Independent declarations should continue semantic analysis after recoverable errors.
Recovery.Limit: After the maximum primary error count, emit a final TooManyDiagnostics error and stop further error discovery.

Rendering.Required: error code, concise message, source path, line/column, highlighted primary span
Rendering.Recommended: related source spans, notes explaining type/range/ownership reason, actionable help when unambiguous

MlxDiagnostics.MachineReadable: JSON output follows spec/02-compiler/diagnostics/json-format.xml and is stable enough for IDEs, CI and coding agents.
MlxDiagnostics.Explain: The compiler distribution provides long-form explanations for stable core diagnostics.
MlxDiagnostics.CompileErrorBuiltin: @compileError produces MLX-E5003 and uses the builtin call span as primary location unless an explicit library diagnostic object supplies a more relevant user source span.
MlxDiagnostics.Warnings: Warnings use MLX-Wxxxx. -Werror promotes warnings to errors without changing their diagnostic identity. Suppression operates by stable code or documented warning group.
MlxDiagnostics.NoStringOnlyErrors: A compiler phase must not communicate a user-facing failure solely as an unstructured string internally.
